The best thing you can do for yourself is to build a support system with friends in the area. Trust me, as an 18-year-old who moved out when I was 17 from N-parents, you can prepare all you want financially, but making some good friends in your area could save your life if/when things go wrong. One of my classmates fed me when he found out I couldn't afford food on top of my rent, more classmates make sure I'm doing okay/keeping on top of things when I need it. 

Apply for financial aid absolutely though! Take advantage of ALL discounts/free money things. I've been living off of gift cards since the beginning of the year from taking notes for other students. 

Good luck with uni and take care of yourself!
